user.title: Nebula
user.description:
Set up the Nebula bridge. This exposes a combined room / scene / automation feed for the Nebula app and panel, advertises this instance on the LAN, and adds connection sensors.

After setup, use the **nebula.pair_code** action (or the panel's pairing screen) to link the app.

pair_code.name: Generate pairing code
pair_code.description: Creates a single-use PIN (valid 5 minutes) to link the Nebula app. The PIN is returned and also shown as a notification.
